failures: Raw failed compiles, pixel checks and source patches are retained. They are never performance trials.
native_transport: 46cfeaa22 exports GPU damage into immutable RGBA IOSurface tiles, clones prior tiles on GPU, retains source/target leases through completion, schedules kernel fences and provides capture completion handles. Optimized/sanitized exact checks and the full existing GPU-canvas suite pass. This transport is not yet integrated into browser publication; no FPS credit.
